comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
SeaRaven, do you have Greek and Spanish language skills? It always helps if either your toon, an aide or fleet member(that hasn't completed the quest already) has the language(s) asked for in the requirements for a quest when trying to get it to show. Also, while I'm not sure of the Adventure fame requirement for this quest(I seem to remember 10k, but it's been over 2 years since I did this quest), I believe the 2nd quest in this chain(Daily-advancing technologies - Salvage r5 and Greek requirements, Athens Adventure Guild) that gets you the Salvager Job card has a 15k Adventure fame requirement.
